messages:
Aisha: Heads up — Daly City BART stuck between stations, announced 25m delay. Anyone coming from down there? :umbrella:
Marco: Ugh, that explains it. I’m heading in from South SF, estimated 40m. If anyone needs a lift from Daly City to SoMa I’ve got room for 2 in the hatchback. DM me.
Priya: Thanks Marco — I’m 2 blocks from Daly City station, could you pick up at Holloway & Howth?
Marco: Yep can do. Leaving in 10.
Samir: Also, the office lobby has a stash of cheap foldable umbrellas by the mailboxes — left them there after last week’s mess.
Priya: Legend. Will grab one if the rain’s still doing its thing. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: BART status update (automated): "Delay due to mechanical issue between Balboa Park and Daly City. Estimated 25-30 minutes. Service resuming with single-tracking."
Mira: FYI 19th St bike lane is flooded near the mural — scooter’s out for me today. Anyone want to swap a dry pair of shoes?
Jules: I have an extra pair of sneakers in size 9. Leaving them by the front desk with a sticky note: "Take if you’re soggy." :droplet:
Aisha: Also, emergency siren went off by Embarcadero earlier — looked dramatic but nothing major. Metro cop said just a false alarm, crowd control.
Samir: Meme time: https://giphy.com/gifs/rain-umbrella-commute-3o6ZsXnH1ZcE -> perfectly describes my calendar today.
Priya: If Marco’s giving rides, I can swing by and bring coffee for the carpool? My treat for soggy commuters. :coffee:
Marco: Coffee accepted. Meet at 8:10 at Holloway & Howth.
Mira: Thank you caravan heroes. If anyone’s stuck and needs a dry spot before 9am ping me — I’ve got space on the 8th floor by the window with a towel.
Aisha: Appreciate everyone — real human infrastructure. :heart:
ops-bot: Reminder: Free commuter lockers available in bike room for the month. See facility notes.
